text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos seized victory in the Oka Sho, 
successfully avenging Verxina's past 
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos rushed into the stands to share her 
joy with her older sister. Seeing her 
little sister so happy, Verxina also 
seemed relieved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though there don't appear to be any major 
issues with her condition after the race, 
you can't let your guard down. She must 
rest up while setting her sights on the 
upcoming Japanese Oaks.
